source_identity.title: The Brownian loop measure on Riemann surfaces and applications to length spectra
source_identity.version_limit: Recorded v3 correction to Corollary1.7; neither v2 bytes nor publisher version were compared.

summary: The central hyperbolic and flat-torus masses, iteration factors, puncturing logic, selected annular consequences and determinant renormalization were checked. Exact symbolic calculations support the constants, and two-precision numerical diagnostics reproduce C2 and C. This bounded initial review does not certify every external theorem or the journal version.

positive_checks.result: Generator Delta and dt/t conventions give O_gamma(t)=L exp(-t/4-L^2/(4t))/(4m sqrt(pi t)sinh(L/2)), mass1/[m(exp L-1)], and flat torus A/(pi|tau|^2). Conjugacy centralizer uses primitive delta and strip heightL/m; orientations remain separate.
Closed polar avoidance, positive-distance exhaustion and free-class partition checked; if gamma'=(delta')^n maps to gamma then n divides m(gamma), using the inclusion homomorphism, not injectivity.

Annular logarithmic modulus r yields core length2pi^2/r and mass1/[|m|(exp(2pi^2|m|/r)-1)]. Expansion r/(2pi^2m^2)-1/(2|m|)+O(1/r); unit-circle subtraction verifies electrical-thickness constant+1/(2|m|).
Cutting torus along primitive simple geodesic gives r=2pi A/ell^2; total minus annular mass exactly matches acquired v3 formula. Positivity, m sign, metric scaling and small-x limit checked.
Given the stated infinite-area finite-type prime-geodesic exponent delta<1, weighted primitive sum converges; elementary cases separate. External counting theorem remains an input.

R(L)=N_X(L)-Li_tilde(exp L)=O(exp((1-epsilon)L)); w=1/(exp L-1) gives wR->0 and integrable w'R. Near-zero support vanishes, so renormalized Stieltjes integral is justified conditionally on the quoted inputs. Gaussian normalization follows by completing the square.

Two independent rearrangements at requested50/80 digits with30 guard digits give C2=0.9380116642341289954279687356141167894... and C=C2-EulerGamma=0.3607959993325961348214566455317143584..., matching0.9380 and0.3608. Numerical diagnostic only, no certified error interval.
